title: 第10章
content_zh: 第十章 我听得懂人话，但是听不懂你说的城南交警中队队长办公室在三楼，中队长是一名步入中年的男子，名叫邓超，国字脸，身材高大，看上去很有正义感的样子。此时却急得没有办法，刚才上头来了电话，说是华家华清逸要来砸了城南交警中队，对于这位出了名的美公子，邓超自然有耳闻，身为华家的第三代接班人，在燕京这个地方少有人能够抗衡，也不知道为什么城南交警中队惹到他什么了。邓超正准备去楼下看看到底发生了什么事情，办公室猛地被踹开了，先头走进来一位极美的男子，身穿白色休闲服，很清新飘逸的样子，只是跟现在他脸上愤怒的表情，有点不搭，而后面那个年轻人也是帅哥一枚，看上去比华清逸祥和多了。不用想，前面进来的这个美男子，估计就是上头说的华家华清逸公子，果然人如其名，清新飘逸，只是后面跟着的那个人，邓超倒是没有半点头绪。华清逸长相虽然清新飘逸，不过做起事来的手段相当的霸气，直接踹了邓超的门进来，然后冷声道：“你是这里的负责人吧？”“华公子有话好说，不知道我们城南交警中队哪里得罪了华公子，还请华公子先消消气！”邓超的姿态摆得很低，形势比人强，虽然邓超这个位置，在一般市民看来，也是手握实权的副处级，但奈何对方来者不善，身世背景更加大得吓人。“你倒是没得罪我，但是得罪我哥，比得罪我还严重！”华清逸没办法恶狠狠的说，毕竟伸手不打笑脸人，对方这么低姿态，华清逸也不好说太过火的话。“华公子的哥哥？”邓超看了看华清逸后面的萧凛，两人不管是面向上气质上或是穿着方面，都有不小的差距，后面那个会是华清逸的哥哥吗？邓超很快的整理了一下思路，小心翼翼的问道，生怕得罪了眼前这一尊大神：“华公子，我能冒昧的问一句吗？”“不能，你只需要按照我说的去做就行了！”华清逸压根不会给邓超询问的机会：“你只需把事故科的那个小交警踢出交警队伍，这件事情我就不追究了！”华家人做事就是霸道，但是人家有这个底气，邓超不由得为难了，能进入事故科的同事又岂是简单之辈，但是形势比人强，邓超低头说道：“华公子，到底是是谁得罪了您哥哥，您说出来，我们一定秉公处理！”“哥，那个小交警叫啥名字？”华清逸转回身向萧凛问道。邓超的目光重新移动到萧凛身上，只见萧凛穿着十分的普通，怎么看都不像是华清逸的哥哥，当然，邓超并没有笨到以为是华清逸的亲哥，但是从华清逸对萧凛的态度可以知道，华清逸对他身后的年轻人是发自内心的尊敬。萧凛摇摇头，道：“我哪知道他叫什么名字，刚才我是气糊涂了，我只知道是事故科的值班交警，现在应该还在上班！”“老邓，知道该怎么做了吧？”华清逸对邓超说道。“一切听华公子安排！”邓超额头上汗珠微现，事故科也有自己安排的亲戚在里面，希望不是他触了华清逸的眉头，否则就算自己是这里的负责人，也救不了他。事故科的谭哥此时一边对另外那名女警员吹嘘，一边拿起电话拨通了吴霜的电话，刚才打了萧凛的脸，自然要向心目中的女神吴霜卖弄一下。“吴队，昨天你交代的事情我已经帮你办好了，还稍微的为难了他一下！”谭哥得意洋洋的说道。“还为难人家了？你怎么为难了？”吴霜的语气有点不满，对于萧凛车子的违规，吴霜最为清楚不过，拖吊已经是最严重的事情了：“我不是跟你说了，他来的话，叫我过去吗？现在他人呢？”“谁叫这小子气你来的，我叫他三天后来取车！”谭哥一付讨好的口气：“我可没有忘记你的吩咐！”吴霜那边倒没有什么好说的了，毕竟指责谭哥的话，会伤了人家的心，不过三天的时间也不算长，虽然有点违规处理，但是问题也不是很大，想了想之后，随便跟谭哥客气了几句，便挂了电话。谭哥这边刚挂电话，萧凛就率先走进来了，得到了吴霜感谢的谭哥，跟打了鸡血似的，一看到萧凛进来，皱了皱眉头，一脸厌恶的说道：“我说你这人听不听得懂人话啊？叫你三天后过来取车！”“我自然听得懂人话，但是听不懂你说的话！”萧凛淡淡的说道，言下之意就是你丫根本不是人，我能听懂你个畜生的话才怪。“信不信我真把你车吊在这里养老？”谭哥大怒，萧凛说的话他怎么可能听不懂，也不知道这小子有什么凭仗，敢再一次回来。萧凛进来的时候，华清逸和邓超并没有跟着进来，萧凛做事还是很有原则的，为了表示自己并不是以势压人，胡编乱造，让邓超和华清逸在门外等着。此时华清逸一听里面谭哥说的话，瞄了邓超一眼，道：“邓队，有的人非要把自己往死路上逼，没救了！”说完，邓超还没反应过来，华清逸直接对着办公室的门踹了一脚。“砰”的一声巨响，顿时惊得整个楼层都惊动了，不少人探出头来，看向事故科这边，却看到一个长得极其妖孽的男子闪身而入事故科，邓超则脸色相当难看的站在门口。里面的声音邓超是听出来了，这人叫谭律，有点儿小背景，叔叔是城南区法院的一名法官，但是跟华清逸这样的家世比起来，简直是天壤之别。邓超跟谭律的叔叔算有点老交情，谭律在私下也叫他叔叔，总不能让别人在自己面前把他给废了，只能硬着头皮跟在华清逸身后走了进去。华清逸的火爆脾气虽然收敛了不少，但是当听到有人这么当面跟萧凛说话，也就忍不住了，踹开办公室的门之后，一进门，抓起放在门口右手边的一只凳子就往那个谭律的头上砸去。;
content_en: Chapter 10 I can understand human speech, but I don’t understand what you are talking about. The office of the captain of the Chengnan Traffic Police Squadron is on the third floor. The squadron leader is a middle-aged man named Deng Chao. He has a Chinese character face, a tall figure, and looks like he has a sense of justice. At this time, he was so anxious that he had no choice. There was a call from above, saying that Hua Qingyi of the Hua family was coming to destroy the Chengnan Traffic Police Squadron. Deng Chaozhou had heard about this famously beautiful young man. As the third generation successor of the Hua family, there were few people in Yanjing who could compete with him. He didn't know why the Chengnan Traffic Police Squadron had offended him. Deng Chao was about to go downstairs to see what was going on. The office was suddenly kicked open. A very beautiful man walked in first, wearing white casual clothes. He looked very fresh and elegant, but it didn't match the angry expression on his face now. The young man behind him was also a handsome guy, and he looked much more peaceful than Hua Qingyi. Needless to say, the handsome man who came in front was probably the Hua Qingyi son mentioned above. As expected, he lived up to his name, fresh and elegant, but Deng Chao didn't have the slightest idea about the man following him. Although Hua Qingyi looks fresh and elegant, the way he does things is quite domineering. He directly kicked Deng Chao's door in and said coldly: "You are the person in charge here, right?" "Young Master Hua has something to say. I don't know where our Chengnan Traffic Police Squadron offended." Mr. Hua, please calm down first!" Deng Chao's posture was very low, and his situation was stronger than others. Although Deng Chao's position, in the eyes of ordinary citizens, was a deputy director with real power, the other party was unkind and his background was even more terrifying. "You didn't offend me, but you offended my brother more than you offended me!" Hua Qingyi couldn't say harshly. After all, he couldn't reach out to hit the smiling man. The other party had such a low profile, so Hua Qingyi couldn't say too much. "Master Hua's brother?" Deng Chao looked at Xiao Lin behind Hua Qingyi. There was a big gap between the two of them in face, temperament, and clothing. Could the one behind him be Hua Qingyi's brother? Deng Chao quickly organized his thoughts and asked cautiously, for fear of offending the great god in front of him: "Master Hua, may I ask a question?" "No, you just need to do as I say!" Hua Qingyi would not give Deng Chao a chance to ask: "You just need to kick the little traffic policeman from the accident department out of the traffic police team, and I will not pursue this matter!" The Hua family is domineering, but they have this confidence. Deng Chao can't help but feel embarrassed. Colleagues who can enter the accident department are not simple people, but the situation is stronger than others. Deng Chao lowered his head and said: "Mr. Hua, who offended your brother, tell me, and we will deal with it impartially!" "Brother, what is the name of that little traffic policeman?" Hua Qingyi turned around and asked Xiao Lin. Deng Chao's eyes moved to Xiao Lin again, and he saw that Xiao Lin was wearing very ordinary clothes. He didn't look like Hua Qingyi's brother. Of course, Deng Chao was not stupid enough to think that he was Hua Qingyi's brother, but from Hua Qingyi's attitude towards Xiao Lin, we could know that Hua Qingyi respected the young man behind him from the bottom of his heart. Xiao Lin shook his head and said, "I don't know his name. I was confused just now. I only know that he is the traffic policeman on duty in the accident department. He should still be working now!" "Old Deng, do you know what to do?" Hua Qingyi said to Deng Chao. "Everything is arranged by Young Master Hua!" There were beads of sweat on Deng Chao's forehead. There were also relatives arranged by him in the accident department. I hope he hadn't touched Hua Qingyi's brow, otherwise even if he was the person in charge here, he wouldn't be able to save him. Brother Tan from the accident department was bragging to the other female police officer at this time, while picking up the phone and dialing Wu Shuang's number. He had just slapped Xiao Lin in the face, so naturally he wanted to show off to the goddess Wu Shuang in his heart. "Captain Wu, I've already helped you with what you told me yesterday, and I even gave him a little trouble!" Brother Tan said proudly. "Are you still embarrassing others? Why are you embarrassing me?" Wu Shuang's tone was a little dissatisfied. Wu Shuang knew the violation of Xiao Lin's car best, but the towing was already the most serious matter: "Didn't I tell you, if he comes, ask me to come over? Where are the others now?" "Who asked this kid to come here because of being angry with you? I asked him to pick up the car in three days!" Brother Tan said in a flattering tone: "I didn't forget your instructions!" Wu Shuang didn't have anything to say. After all, blaming Brother Tan would hurt people's hearts, but three days was not a long time. Although it was a bit illegal, the problem was not too big. After thinking about it, he was polite to Brother Tan and hung up the phone. As soon as Brother Tan hung up the phone, Xiao Lin walked in first. Brother Tan, who was thanked by Wu Shuang, felt like he had been given a shot of chicken blood. When he saw Xiao Lin coming in, he frowned and said with a look of disgust: "I said you don't understand. "Human language? I asked you to come and pick up the car in three days!" "Of course I can understand human language, but I can't understand what you said!" Xiao Lin said lightly, the implication being that you are not a human at all, it's strange that I can understand what you are saying. "Believe it or not, I will hang your car here to retire?" Brother Tan was furious. How could he not understand what Xiao Lin said, and he didn't know what the boy had to rely on to dare to come back again. When Xiao Lin came in, Hua Qingyi and Deng Chao did not follow him in. Xiao Lin was still very principled in doing things. In order to show that he was not using power to pressure others, he made up random things and asked Deng Chao and Hua Qingyi to wait outside the door. At this time, when Hua Qingyi heard what Brother Tan said inside, he glanced at Deng Chao and said: "Captain Deng, some people insist on driving themselves to death. There is no hope!" After saying that, before Deng Chao could react, Hua Qingyi kicked the office door directly. There was a loud "bang" sound, and the whole building was shocked.
